title: Civic Hall Wayback CDX review for January 2016 event evidence
scope: Civic Hall public web captures relevant to recovering a dedicated event page, listing, agenda, registration content, or breakout roster for the January 30, 2016 NYC Council hackathon.
method: Wayback CDX review of Civic Hall captures, deduplicated HTML captures, URL keys, event URL paths, successful captures, redirects, and not-found captures.
findings: No dedicated Civic Hall calendar listing for the January 30, 2016 NYC Council hackathon was recovered in this run.
No full agenda, breakout roster, or registration-form contents for the event were recovered in this run.
The absence of recovered pages is an archival finding only; it must not be phrased as proof of nonexistence.
guardrail: Say not recovered, never did not exist.
protectedBoundaries: Do not publish raw CDX exports or local analysis paths.
